race.title: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
race.verdict: MASEGO has made a positive start for Tony Carroll, beaten only by a new stablemate at Southwell on his latest outing, and he could be ready to get back to winning ways returned to this longer trip. He gets the vote ahead of Sea of Charm , who quickly bounced back to form last week, while Stitching Wheel is interesting on her stable debut. MASEGO (IRE) SEA OF CHARM (FR) STITCHING WHEEL (IRE)
